note: Generic starting values of the plastic rule. kind cited means the value is printed in the source; derived means it is chosen inside a printed range or between printed values and basis says how. Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees. These are starting proportions from public design guides, not a supplier guarantee; the rule is editable per part.

sources.PRO: Protolabs, Injection Molding Wall Thickness Guidelines, https://www.protolabs.com/resources/design-tips/improving-part-design-with-uniform-wall-thickness/
sources.COV: Bayer MaterialScience (Covestro), Part and Mold Design, mirror copy https://kompozit.org.tr/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/A_Design_Guide_Part_and_Mold_Design_Engi.pdf
sources.DUP: DuPont, Engineering Polymers General Design Principles, https://www.delrin.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-1.pdf
sources.BAY: Bayer MaterialScience, Snap-Fit Joints for Plastics, https://fab.cba.mit.edu/classes/S62.12/people/vernelle.noel/Plastic_Snap_fit_design.pdf
sources.SPA: Tim Spahr (Ticona/Celanese), Snap-Fits for Assembly and Disassembly, https://www.gotstogo.com/misc/engineering_info/Snap_Fitsres72dpi.PDF
sources.DUK: Dukane, Guide to Ultrasonic Plastics Assembly, https://documents.dukane.com/DesignGuides/Guide%20To%20US%20Plastic%20Assembly.pdf

wall_variation_pct.basis: allowable variation of the nominal wall for low shrink amorphous or filled resins; about half for unfilled crystalline resins

adjacent_ratio_min.basis: walls no less than 40 to 60 percent of adjacent walls; the 40 percent end is used

min_draft.basis: minimum 0.5 degree per side for most materials; DUP allows 0 to 0.25 degree for some unfilled engineering resins and BAS asks 1 degree, the stricter COV value is used

recommended_draft.basis: 1 degree where possible; BAS: at least 1 degree per side for problem free demoulding

texture_draft_per_mm.basis: 1 degree extra per 0.001 in (0.0254 mm) of texture depth; DUP agrees with 1 degree per 0.025 mm

rib_ratio_min.basis: rib and boss walls at 40 to 60 percent of the adjacent wall; the material table overrides

rib_height_max_ratio.basis: rib height generally at most 3 times the rib base thickness; DUP asks a buckling check above 5 times

rib_spacing_min_ratio.basis: short rib spacing at least 2 times the wall

rib_base_fillet_ratio.basis: between 0.125 of the rib thickness (COV) and 0.5 of the rib thickness (DUP)

boss_od_ratio.basis: outside diameter 2.0 to 2.4 times the screw outside diameter (COV); middle of the range

boss_od_ratio_insert.basis: boss outside diameter 2 to 3 times the hole diameter (DUP); middle of the range for inserts

boss_height_max_ratio.basis: bosses taller than 5 times their outside diameter need special attention

corner_radius_ratio_min.basis: radius to thickness about 0.15 is a compromise and stress concentration rises sharply below about 0.2

snap_repeat_factor.basis: use about 60 percent of the permissible strain for frequent separation and rejoining; SPA gives the same 0.6

snap_root_radius_min.basis: root fillet at least 0.020 in; BAY gives 0.015 in (0.381 mm) as the least

snap_friction.basis: the friction coefficient of the worked example of BAY (mu 0.6); a value for one material pair, edit it for yours

lip_width_ratio.basis: tongue width W/3 for a tongue and groove joint, W the wall

groove_extra_width.basis: groove width = tongue width + 0.004 to 0.008 in (0.10 to 0.20 mm); middle

groove_extra_depth.basis: groove depth = tongue height minus 0.005 to 0.010 in (0.13 to 0.25 mm) for a welded joint, so a welded groove is 0.2 mm shallower; an unwelded closure uses 0.2 mm deeper

lip_clearance.basis: clearance per side 0.002 to 0.004 in (0.05 to 0.10 mm); the larger end

lip_draft.basis: groove sidewall angle 3 to 5 degrees; the smaller end

lip_min_wall.basis: a tongue W/3 wide needs a wall of at least 1.5 mm to be 0.5 mm wide; a design limit of this rule, not a printed minimum

welded_min_wall.basis: minimum wall 0.120 in for a tongue and groove welded joint
